customManagers.description: Pinned Nextcloud app tarballs seeded by initContainers. Renovate can only bump the release tag in the URL path; the postUpgradeTask below reconciles the versioned filename, the desired_version arg, and the sha256 (recomputed from the tarball) so the PR is complete and mergeable.

packageRules.description: smartctl-exporter v0.15.0 returns HTTP 500 with zero metrics on srv9 (SAS disks behind the PERC H730P) - it fails the whole /metrics response, blinding the node. Re-verified 2026-10-26 that it is not fixable via --smartctl.device-exclude. Block the 0.15.x line only, so a fixed 0.16 is still proposed. See apps/monitoring/smartctl-exporter/daemonset.yaml.
